text:
nina: Noticed a spate of onboarding issues: sample apps show different errors for the same backend response. New devs don't know whether to refresh creds or request scopes.

omar: Yeah — inconsistent surface area is the root cause. We should pick a small set of "intents" and ensure every SDK maps HTTP -> intent -> typed error + one-line UX hint.

ting: Proposal: intents = authn, authz, quota, conflict, server. SDK errors: AuthenticationError, PermissionDenied, RateLimitError, ConflictError, ServerError. Keep messages user-facing and brief.

ben: Important: separate "what to show users" vs "what we log". Users see a concise hint; logs include full body, trace_id, and raw status.

omar: Example user message patterns:
- AuthenticationError: "Authentication failed — refresh your API key or re-run login."
- PermissionDenied: "Permission denied — your key lacks 'inference.write'. Request access or use a different key."
- RateLimitError: "Rate limit exceeded — retry after Xs."

ting: SDK layer sketch (pseudo):
```
if status==401: raise AuthenticationError('Authentication failed — refresh token')
elif status==403: raise PermissionDenied("Permission denied — missing scope 'inference.write'")
elif status==429: raise RateLimitError('Rate limit exceeded', retry_after)
```

nina: Also: quickstart currently creates a key with only read scopes. For write examples either broaden those default scopes or change examples to read-only. Newbie UX is suffering.

ben: We'll add telemetry keys error_intent and error_label. Also request SDK unit tests that assert the public message is concise and actionable.

omar: I'll open a tiny doc in /docs/error-intents.md and a ticket for SDK owners to implement the mapping and tests.

devex-bot: Ticket created: DEVEX-3101 "Error intent parity + concise UX" assigned to @omar, @ting. https://tickets.example/DEVEX-3101

ting: Great — I'll land the docs + sampleapp patch this sprint.
